title: Ode to the Riemann Hypothesis — Symphony in 53-EDO
description: A monumental ~15-minute (900s) stage-independent 4-movement 53-EDO orchestral symphony tracing the mathematical epic of the Riemann Hypothesis: I. The Primes (prime-limit harmonics 2,3,5,7,11,13,17,19, Sieve of Eratosthenes polyrhythms & Euler Product); II. Analytic Continuation (Re(s)=1 divergence wall, chromatic-mediant diesis rotations, exact xi(s)=xi(1-s) simultaneous mirror-inversion counterpoint & palindromic arch, first nontrivial zero); III. A Century of Small Progress (10-variation Brahmsian/Brucknerian Passacaglia & 4-voice Fugato climbing k=0->+1->+2->+3 to an unresolved summit); IV. The Proof: AI & The Critical Line (hyper-parallel algorithmic lattice locking onto k=0 in a Cathedral Pipe Organ + full-orchestra triple-theme Proof Apotheosis & Critical Line stillness).
